comment: K1001 and K1019 supplied the progress estimates: D≈0.512, C≈0.154 with momentum-MSE calibration, A≈0.0154, B≈0.0453, and E≈0.00136. D’s adaptive progress supported first place; C combined substantial progress with ReLU and normalization. K1008 supported the rectifier candidates, while K1012 cautioned against mechanically sorting close cross-optimizer displacement estimates. A’s normalized LeakyReLU architecture plausibly outweighed B’s roughly threefold progress advantage with zero-LN SiLU. E’s tiny Adagrad displacement supported last place. The gold confirms this full-recipe ordering, but does not isolate activation, normalization placement, or optimizer effects. No new tested general rule follows.
